name: Yamashita Kumi
source:
Kumi is a more refined specimen. She works as a salesgirl at the candy shop "Taishido". She usually wears a traditional kimono which, combined with her calm and relaxed air, makes her seem more mature than the other girls. She often comes by the shop specifically to visit [url=https://vndb.org/c27885]Takashi[/url] but will also get interested in [url=https://vndb.org/c27886]Takuya[/url] later on aswell.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/915699-target-pheromone/faqs/29067]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
